name: XiaoChun AI Companion
description: Bring cheerful, healing XiaoChun into your Cindy! Your personal AI companion stays peacefully in the sidebar or floats as a transparent desktop pet, with natural voice reading, delicate expressions, lively gestures, instant outfit swaps, dancing and multi-angle cameras.
whenToUse: Use when user wants AI companion XiaoChun to speak, read text, perform body gestures, express emotions, or create and set up dedicated XiaoChun bot teammate.

xiaochun_speak.description: Make AI companion XiaoChun speak aloud with synchronized gestures and facial expressions. Zero installation required. If switched to desktop mode and stopped, it will automatically cold-start.

/properties/text.description: The exact text content for XiaoChun to speak and express with natural voice (supports long text reading).

/properties/motion.description: Optional motion or motion group name. Examples: 'greeting', 'think', 'nod', 'wave', 'praiseCute', 'playfulSulking', 'dancePerformance'.

/properties/force.description: Whether to force speaking (default false). When false, it will prompt user to finish the art0 onboarding tour if in progress.

xiaochun_motion.description: Trigger a standalone motion or animation group on XiaoChun without speaking.

/properties/name.description: The motion or animation group name, e.g. 'greeting', 'waving', 'think', 'handHeart', 'praiseCute', 'dancePerformance'.

/properties/loop.description: Whether to loop the motion playback, defaults to false.

xiaochun_camera.description: Adjust XiaoChun's desktop camera angle, framing, or movement.

/properties/action.description: Camera action command: 'pan_up' (smoothly tilt/pan up), 'reset' (reset camera to default angle).

xiaochun_scene.description: Switch XiaoChun desktop stage scene (e.g. beach3d beach world, transparent desktop pet overlay, dark stage, light stage, void, etc.).

/properties/persist.description: Whether to persist this scene choice as default for future launches, defaults to true.

xiaochun_outfit.description: Switch XiaoChun's outfit (dinner dress, cheongsam, techwear, bikini, maid, default, etc.) with 0-frame seamless delta swap preserving current motion, expression, and gaze.

/properties/name.description: Outfit identifier name or alias. Options: 'dinner_dress', 'cheongsam', 'techwear', 'bikini', 'maid', 'default'.

xiaochun_stop.description: Immediately stop XiaoChun's ongoing speech and animation, smoothly transitioning back to natural idle posture.

xiaochun_status.description: Query XiaoChun active runtime mode (desktop pet mode / Cindy embed panel mode), installation, active state, onboarding progress, current scene and outfit.

xiaochun_bootstrap.description: Query or configure XiaoChun runtime mode ('desktop' pet / 'embed' panel). Note: embed mode is default and zero-install. Never install desktop app without explicit user consent in conversation.

/properties/action.description: Action to take: 'ensure' (auto-detect and prepare readiness, default), 'install' (download and install desktop client ONLY upon explicit user consent), 'launch' (wake up installed client), 'switch_mode' (switch desktop/embed mode). Defaults to 'ensure'.

/properties/mode.description: Runtime morphology mode: 'auto' (auto-detect, desktop if installed, embed or guide if missing), 'desktop' (enforce desktop pet), 'embed' (use Cindy embed panel window, zero install). Defaults to 'auto'.

/properties/userConfirmed.description: Whether the user explicitly confirmed consent to install the desktop client in chat. Must only be true when user confirmed.

xiaochun_update.description: Check for XiaoChun desktop client updates from GitHub Releases. Defaults to 'check' (query only). Only specify 'install' with userConfirmed=true if user affirmatively requests update.

/properties/mode.description: Execution mode: 'check' (check only without installing, default), or 'install' (download, install, and relaunch upon user confirmation). Defaults to 'check'.

/properties/userConfirmed.description: Whether the user explicitly confirmed consent to update the desktop client.
